claims.text: The Singapore EDITION is in the upper Orchard Road shopping district, a short walk from the Singapore Botanic Garden.

findings.quote: Nestled at the pulse of the upper Orchard Road shopping district and ideally located a short walk from the UNESCO-lauded Singapore Botanic Garden

claims.text: The rooms and suites have decor and detailing by Ian Schrager.

findings.quote: feature stylishly modern decor and posh detailing by Ian Schrager

claims.text: Guest room floors are white oak planks with warm white rugs, and the beds have hand-sewn damask throws.

findings.quote: White oak-planked floors are adorned with warm white rugs, while hand-sewn damask throws swathe the beds.

claims.text: Tanica serves modern Asian cuisine flavoured with regional herbs and spices, grilled over the Josper or char-fried in the wok.

findings.quote: modern Asian cuisine, flavoured with regional herbs and spices, grilled over the Josper or char-fried in the wok.

claims.text: Tanica is on level one past the Lobby Bar, and a spiral staircase leads down to the lower ground bars.

findings.quote: Wander from level one past the Lobby Bar to find Tanica for a sumptuous Josper-grilled meal, then let the spiral staircase lead you down to lower ground, where the night lights up with cocktails and music.

claims.text: Punch Room is a bar done in Yves Klein blue, with oak-panelled walls and ceilings and a blue ceiling pendant by Parisian artist Eric Schmitt.

findings.quote: Punch Room is housed in an intimate space swathed in Yves Klein blue: oak-panelled walls and ceilings, a sculptural blue ceiling pendant by Parisian artist Eric Schmitt

claims.text: The Lobby Bar has sharp pink velvet walls and a rose-colored pool table of Calacutta marble.

findings.quote: The Lobby Bar is an eye-popping space sheathed in sharp pink velvet where a rose-colored pool table of Calacutta marble

claims.text: The spa is on the second floor and has seven treatment rooms.

findings.quote: The Spa at The Singapore EDITION, situated on the second floor of the hotel. Discover a sanctuary of tranquility and rejuvenation with seven exquisite treatment rooms

claims.text: The spa's changing suites have thermal pools, an ice fountain, a sauna and steam rooms.

findings.quote: his-and-her changing suites, complete with invigorating thermal pools, an ice fountain, sauna, steam rooms

claims.text: The gym is on the second floor, open 24 hours, with TechnoGym equipment.

findings.quote: Located on the second floor, the 24-hour Gym at The Singapore EDITION is equipped with state-of-the-art cardio and strength-building equipments, free weights, yoga mats, exercise balls, and a variety of premium equipment by TechnoGym.

claims.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool.
